title: Retry failed observation
description: Re-run a `failed` or `ineligible` replay vision observation. The observation row is deleted and the scanner scans the same recording again, costing credits like any scan. Returns a `workflow_id`. The replacement has a new id, so find it with `vision-observations-list` for the same `session_id`. Check `error_reason` first: `too_short` or `no_recording` usually comes back ineligible again. A 409 means the previous run is still finishing; retry in a moment.

methodDocumentation.text: Delete a failed or ineligible observation and re-run its scanner on the same recording. Returns 202 with the workflow handle.
